blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Emotion recognition in artworks remains challenging because affective meaning is often subjective, implicit, and shaped by relationships between visual form and semantic associations. While vision-language models provide strong multimodal representations, direct image-to-emotion prediction may overlook explicit relations among formal, semantic, and affective cues that support emotional interpretation. This paper proposes Visual-Semantic Affect Graphs (VSAG), a graph-based framework that represents artworks through interpretable feature nodes, including color, brushstroke, composition, light-shadow, line quality, and extracted visual entities. The graph learns feature-emotion associations for dominant emotion prediction, with valence-arousal structure modeled through an optional hierarchical auxiliary affect module. We evaluate VSAG and VSAG-TopK against direct VLM inference using Qwen3-VL and InternVL3.5 on EmoArt-5k. Results show that direct VLMs provide useful but modest baselines, while graph-based models improve dominant emotion prediction. In particular, the hierarchical valence-arousal variant of VSAG achieves the best overall performance, improving accuracy, macro-F1, and weighted-F1 over both direct VLM inference and the emotion-only VSAG baseline. Per-class results indicate that graph-based models and VLMs capture partly complementary signals, while valence-arousal structure is most useful when integrated as a coarse-to-fine affect hierarchy rather than as a simple post-hoc correction. These findings suggest that explicit visual-semantic structure can support both prediction and interpretation in artwork emotion recognition.
blocks.zh: 艺术作品中的情感识别仍然具有挑战性,因为情感意义往往是主观的,隐含的,由视觉形式和语义联系之间的关系所塑造. 虽然视觉语言模型提供了强有力的多模式表述,但直接的图像到情感预测可能会忽略支持情感解释的正式、语义和情感提示之间的明确关系。 本文提出了Visual-Semantic Afffect Graphs(VSAG),这是一个以图表为基础的框架,通过可解释的特征节点代表了艺术品,包括颜色,刷子,组成,光影,行质量,被取取取的视觉实体. 该图为主性情感预测学习了特征-情感关联,通过可选的分级辅助影响模块来模拟活性-激发结构. 我们对VSAG和VSAG-TopK进行评估,对照使用Qune3-VL和InternVL3.5在EmoArt-5k上的直接VLM推论. 结果显示,直接的VLM提供了有用而适度的基线,而以图表为基础的模型则改善了占主导地位的情感预测. 特别是,VSAG的分级活性-振荡变体实现了最佳的整体性能,提高了精度,宏观-F1和加权-F1都超过了直接VLM推论和仅以情感为主的VSAG基线. 每个类的结果表明以图为基础的模型和VLM部分地捕捉到互补的信号,而活性-振荡结构在作为粗细到细细的集成物而影响层次而不是简单的后热校正时最为有用. 这些研究结果表明,清晰的视觉语义结构可以支持在艺术情感识别中的预测和解释.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: “A work of art which did not begin in emotion is not art.” — Paul Cézanne —
blocks.zh: “没有情感开始的艺术作品不是艺术。”

blocks.en: This idea is not only an aesthetic statement, but also represents a potential computational challenge. If emotion is central to artistic meaning, then an artificial intelligence system that merely recognizes depicted objects, styles, or iconographic motifs has not yet understood an artwork in the way human viewers often do. Computationally, this requires connecting visual form to annotated affective response: how color, composition, texture, rhythm, light, abstraction, and symbolic association may contribute to how an artwork is labeled as feeling. In this sense, emotion prediction in art asks whether a model can move beyond visual description toward a deeper interpretation of aesthetic experience.
blocks.zh: 这个想法不仅是一个审美陈述,还代表着潜在的计算挑战. 如果情感是艺术意义的核心,那么仅仅承认所描绘的物体,风格,或图示摩蒂夫的人工智能系统还没有像人类观众通常那样理解出一件艺术品. 依计算,这需要将视觉形式与附加说明的情感反应联系起来:颜色、组成、纹理、节奏、光线、抽象和象征性的结合如何有助于将艺术品贴上感觉的标签。 在这个意义上,艺术中的情感预测质问一个模型是否能够超越视觉描述而更深入地诠释审美体验.

blocks.en: Vision-language models have shown strong performance in general visual-language understanding, suggesting that large-scale image-text pretraining can capture broad semantic knowledge from images [ 12 ] . However, affective understanding remains more difficult than recognizing objects, actions, or scenes. Human emotions are often implicit, context-dependent, subjective, and expressed through subtle visual or linguistic cues rather than directly observable categories. Recent studies suggest that VLMs can struggle with such affective reasoning, showing sensitivity to prompts and labels, bias toward frequent emotion categories, and difficulty distinguishing rare or complex emotions from more common neighboring ones [ 4 , 11 , 2 ] . These limitations suggest that strong visual-language alignment alone may not be sufficient for robust emotion understanding.
blocks.zh: 视觉-语言模型在一般视觉-语言理解中表现出了很强的性能,表明大规模图像-文本预训可以从图像中获取广义的语义知识[12]. 然而,与识别物体、行动或场景相比,情感理解仍然更加困难。 人类的情感往往是隐含的,上下文依赖的,主观的,并通过微妙的视觉或语言提示表达,而不是直接可观察到的类别. 近期的研究表明,VLMs可以与这种情感推理相抗衡,表现出对提示和标签的敏感性,偏向于频繁的情感类别,难以区分稀有或复杂的情感与更常见的相邻情感[4,11,2]. 这些限制表明,仅靠强烈的视觉语言对接可能不足以实现强烈的情感理解.

blocks.en: This challenge becomes especially important in the study of artworks. Unlike many ordinary images, artworks evoke emotion not only through depicted objects or scenes, but also through formal and aesthetic components, like color, texture, composition, light, line, brushwork, spatial balance, and style. Psychological and neuroaesthetic accounts of art perception have long argued that aesthetic experience involves emotion, valuation, memory, and interpretation rather than visual recognition alone [ 18 , 15 ] . Earlier computational studies on affective image and art analysis similarly emphasized that emotion prediction benefits from features motivated by psychology and art theory, including color, texture, composition, and semantic content [ 14 ] . These observations suggest that progress in artwork emotion prediction may require not only larger models, but also intermediate representations that make affect-relevant visual and semantic cues explicit.
blocks.zh: 这一挑战在艺术研究中变得特别重要。 艺术作品与许多普通图像不同,不仅通过被描绘的物体或场景,而且通过形式和美学成分,如颜色、纹理、组成、光线、线条、刷子、空间平衡和风格,激发出情感。 对艺术感知的心理和神经美学描述长期以来一直认为,美学体验涉及情感,估值,记忆和解释,而不是光是视觉识别[18,15]. 早期对情感影像和艺术分析的计算研究同样强调,情感预测得益于由心理学和艺术理论所激发的特征,包括颜色,纹理,组成,和语义内容[14]. 这些观察表明,在艺术情感预测方面取得进展,不仅需要更大的模型,而且需要中间表述,使与影响有关的视觉和语义提示明确。

blocks.en: In this paper, we examine whether graph-based visual-semantic representations offer a more effective way to model emotion in art than direct VLM inference. Instead of treating an artwork as an isolated image, we represent it as an artwork-feature graph whose nodes encode affect-relevant attributes such as color, brushstroke, composition, light, line quality, and visual entities. The graph supports dominant emotion prediction, with valence-arousal group structure modeled through an optional hierarchical auxiliary module. We address three research questions:
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们审视了以图表为基础的视觉语义表达是否提供了比直接VLM推论更能有效模拟艺术中情感的方法. 我们不把它当作一个孤立的图像, 而是把它当作一个艺术地貌图, 其节点编码会影响相关的属性, 如颜色、刷子、组成、光线、线条质量和视觉实体。 该图支持主流情感预测,通过可选的分级辅助模块来建模活性-激发群结构. 我们处理三个研究问题:

blocks.en: RQ1: How well do current vision-language models predict the emotions evoked by artworks? RQ2: Can graph-based visual-semantic representations improve artwork emotion prediction beyond direct VLM inference? RQ3: Which visual-semantic attributes are most strongly associated with specific emotions?
blocks.zh: RQ1:当前视觉语言模型对艺术所引发的情绪的预测有多好? RQ2:基于图表的视觉语义表达能超越直接的VLM推论改善艺术情感预测吗? RQ3 : (英语). 哪些视觉语义属性与特定情感关系最紧密?

blocks.en: The rest of this paper is organized as follows: Section 2 reviews some related works. Section 3 introduces the proposed VSAG framework, including graph construction, VSAG-TopK, hierarchical valence-arousal auxiliary modeling, and training. Section 4 presents the dataset, emotion prediction results, and feature-emotion association analysis. Section 5 discusses the main findings and limitations. Finally, Section 6 concludes the paper and outlines future directions.
blocks.zh: 本文件其余部分按下列方式编排: 第2节审查一些相关的作品。 第3节介绍了拟议的VSAG框架,包括图建、VSAG-TopK、分级活率-振动辅助模型的建立和培训。 第4节介绍了数据集、情感预测结果和特征-情感关联分析。 第5节讨论了主要调查结果和局限性。 最后,第6节总结了该文件并概述了今后的方向。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Research on emotion in visual art draws from both categorical and dimensional theories of affect. Discrete emotion models [ 9 ] describe affect through labels such as joy, sadness, fear, or anger, while dimensional models [ 19 ] represent emotion through properties such as valence and arousal. This distinction is important for art because artworks often evoke emotion indirectly, through visual form, symbolic meaning, personal association, and cultural knowledge. Art-specific datasets such as WikiArt Emotions [ 16 ] , ArtEmis [ 1 ] , and FeelingBlue [ 3 ] have enabled larger-scale study of evoked emotion in artworks. However, recent AI-and-art research has increasingly focused on generative tasks, especially text-to-image generation, image editing, and diffusion-based visual art creation [ 20 , 24 ] . While these works show rapid progress in producing or editing artistic images, emotion prediction in art remains comparatively less explored. This gap is important because art emotion recognition is not only a labeling task, but also an interpretive problem involving visual form, semantic association, and affective response.
blocks.zh: 对视觉艺术中的情感的研究,既取自绝对论,又取自维度论的影响. 分明的情感模型[9]通过快乐,悲伤,恐惧,或愤怒等标签来描述影响,而维度模型[19]则通过英勇和激动等属性来代表情感. 这种区别对艺术很重要,因为艺术品往往通过视觉形式、象征意义、个人联系和文化知识间接地激发情感。 艺术特有数据集,如维基艺术情感[16],ArtEmis[1],和Feel Blue[3],使得艺术中激发出情感的研究得以更大规模地进行. 然而,最近的AI-and-art研究越来越注重基因任务,特别是文本到图像生成,图像编辑,以及基于传播的视觉艺术创作[20,24]. 虽然这些作品在制作或编辑艺术图像方面显示出了迅速的进展,但艺术中的情感预测仍然相对较少被探索. 这一差距很重要,因为艺术情感识别不仅是标签任务,也是涉及视觉形式,语义联系,和情感反应的解释性问题.

blocks.en: Vision-language models have become strong foundations for multimodal understanding, including image-text retrieval, captioning, visual question answering, and multimodal reasoning [ 12 , 13 , 22 ] . However, strong general visual-language performance does not guarantee reliable affective understanding. Emotion is subjective, context-dependent, and often weakly grounded in visible objects. Prior work suggests that VLM predictions can be sensitive to prompts and label formulations, and that generic visual-language representations are not always aligned with human affective judgments [ 6 , 4 ] . This limitation is especially relevant for art, where emotional meaning may depend on relations among color, form, composition, and symbolic content.
blocks.zh: 愿景语言模型已成为多模式理解的坚实基础,包括图像文本检索、标题、视觉问答和多模式推理[12、13、22]。 然而,强壮的一般视觉语言表现并不能保证可靠的情感理解. 情感是主观的,依赖上下文的,并且常常被弱化地扎根于可见物体上. 之前的工作表明,VLM预测可以对提示和标签配体敏感,而通用视觉语言表达方式并不总是与人类的情感判断相配合[6,4]. 这种限制对艺术特别相关,其中情感意义可能取决于颜色,形式,组成和象征内容之间的关系.

blocks.en: Graph representations provide a way to make visual and semantic structure explicit. In computer vision, scene graphs and knowledge graphs organize objects, attributes, relations, and contextual knowledge for visual reasoning [ 10 ] . Similar ideas have been used in computational art analysis, where resources such as ArtGraph [ 7 ] and ArtKB [ 5 ] show that artwork understanding can benefit from structured information beyond pixels. Graph learning methods further provide tools for using relational structure in prediction [ 21 , 17 ] . However, it remains unclear whether graph-based learning over visual-semantic artwork attributes improves emotion prediction. Our work addresses this question by constructing an affect-focused artwork-feature graph and comparing it with direct VLM inference.
blocks.zh: 图表表述提供了一种使视觉和语义结构清晰化的方法. 在计算机视觉中,场景图和知识图为视觉推理组织对象,属性,关系和背景知识[10]. 在计算艺术分析中也采用了类似的想法,ArtGraph[7]和ArtKB[5]等资源表明,艺术理解可以受益于像素以外的结构化信息. 图表学习方法进一步提供了在预测中使用关系结构的工具[21,17]. 然而,仍然不清楚的是,基于图表的学习是否比视觉语义艺术属性更能改善情感预测。 我们的工作通过绘制一个注重影响的艺术特征图来解决这一问题,并将它与直接的VLM推论进行比较。

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: Figure 1: Overview of the proposed Visual-Semantic Affect Graph framework.
blocks.zh: 图1:拟议的视觉 -- -- 语义 -- -- 图形框架概述。

blocks.en: Figure 1 gives an overview of the proposed framework. We formulate artwork emotion prediction as structured prediction over a visual-semantic affect graph. Rather than directly mapping an image to an emotion label, we first represent each artwork through interpretable visual-semantic features and then learn how these features support dominant emotion prediction. The emotion-only model decodes the final emotion directly from graph-based emotion scores. The +VA variant uses the valence-arousal structure of the emotion label space as a coarse-to-fine hierarchy: the model predicts a four-way valence-arousal group and a within-group emotion distribution. In VSAG+VA, these outputs provide the hierarchical final decoder; in VSAG-TopK+VA, they are used as auxiliary regularization while final decoding remains direct.
blocks.zh: 图1概述了拟议框架。 我们用视觉语义影响图 来进行艺术情感预测 我们不直接将一个图像映射到情感标签上,而是首先通过可解释的视觉语义特征来代表每个艺术,然后学习这些特征如何支持占主导地位的情感预测. 只有情感的模型直接从以图表为基础的情感分数中解码出最终情感. +VA变体以情感标签空间的活性-活性结构为粗细分级: 该模型预测出一个四向活性-活性组和群内情感分布. 在VSAG+VA中,这些输出提供了分级的最终解码器;在VSAG-TopK+VA中,它们被用作辅助规范,而最终解码仍然直接.

blocks.en: Attribute Categorization
blocks.zh: 属性分类

blocks.en: Artwork images can often be described through basic visual elements such as color, line, texture, composition, and light. These elements provide a structured description of how the image is visually constructed, and they are important cues for affective interpretation. We first convert visual attribute descriptions into controlled categorical feature nodes. Specifically, we categorize brushstroke, color, composition, light-shadow, and line-quality descriptions using predefined lexical rules. This reduces noisy free-text descriptions into a smaller and more consistent feature vocabulary while preserving interpretable visual cues. Each matched category becomes a feature node connected to the corresponding artwork node.
blocks.zh: 艺术作品的图像往往可以通过基本的视觉元素来描述,例如颜色,行,纹理,构成,和光. 这些元素对图像的视觉构造提供了有条理的描述,它们是感人解释的重要提示. 我们首先将视觉属性描述转换为受控制的绝对特征节点. 具体来说,我们用预先定义的词典规则来分类刷子、颜色、组成、光影和行质量描述。 这将吵闹的自由文字描述简化为更小更一致的特征词汇,同时保留可解释的视觉提示. 每个匹配的分类成为连接到相应艺术节点的特征节点.

blocks.en: Entity Extraction
blocks.zh: 实体采掘

blocks.en: Beyond formal attributes, an artwork may contain depicted entities or visual resemblances that provide semantic cues, especially in abstract art. These cues may include objects, motifs, scene elements, or concrete resemblances such as figure , boat , tree , or circle . Because such terms are open-vocabulary, we use a text LLM to extract depicted things from the artwork description while excluding formal visual-analysis terms. The prompt is abbreviated below:
blocks.zh: 除了形式上的属性,一幅艺术品可能包含描绘的实体或视觉相貌,提供语义提示,特别是在抽象艺术中. 这些提示可能包括物体、齿轮、场景元素,或者具体相似之处,如图、船、树或圆等。 由于这些术语是开放式的,我们用一个LLM文本从艺术描述中提取所描绘的东西,同时排除正式的视觉分析术语. 提示缩写如下:

Keep examples : dot , circle , house , figure , face , tree , flower , animal , bird , landscape , mosaic , geometric motif . Exclude : color / palette , brushstroke / texture , line / edge , composition / arrangement , lighting / shadow / depth , emotion / mood , movement / rhythm , and generic visual words . Rules : return lowercase singular noun phrases ; remove color / style adjectives unless essential ; return [] if no concrete entity exists . Output JSON only : {" entities ": [" entity one ", " entity two "]}

blocks.en: The label distribution is highly imbalanced, as shown in Table 2 . The dataset is dominated by the Calm class, which accounts for more than half of all artworks. In contrast, several emotion classes contain only a small number of examples, such as Glad , Aroused , Bored , Tired , and Annoyed . This imbalance makes the task challenging because a model can obtain high overall accuracy by favoring frequent emotions, while still performing poorly on rare affective categories. For this reason, we report both distribution-sensitive metrics, such as accuracy and weighted-F1, and class-balanced metrics, such as macro-F1.
blocks.zh: 如表2所示,标签分发高度不平衡。 数据集以"平分"为主,占了所有艺术品的一半以上. 对比之下,一些情感课只包含少量的例子,如Glad , Areated, Bored, tired, 和 Annoyed. 这种不平衡使得任务具有挑战性,因为一个模型可以通过偏好频繁的情绪来获得高整体准确性,同时在稀有的情感类上仍然表现不佳. 因此,我们既报告对分配敏感的度量,如精确度和加权-F1,也报告类平衡度量,如宏观-F1。

blocks.en: After applying the visual attribute categorization and entity extraction steps described in Section 3 , we obtain the visual-semantic feature statistics summarized in Table 3 . Each artwork contains a short description of about 36 words on average. The visual attribute fields produce compact feature sets, with roughly 2 to 3 categorical nodes per attribute type. The entity extractor adds a more open-ended semantic layer, contributing 4.06 normalized entity nodes per artwork on average, and 5,281 unique normalized visual entity nodes over the dataset.

blocks.en: 4.2 Emotion Prediction Performance
blocks.zh: 4.2 情绪预测性能

blocks.en: Table 4: Dominant emotion prediction performance. Best values are shown in bold.
blocks.zh: 表4:主要情感预测性能. 最佳值以粗体显示。

blocks.en: Table 5: Per-class F1 scores for dominant emotion prediction. Best values are shown in bold.
blocks.zh: 表5:主情感预测的每等F1分. 最佳值以粗体显示。

blocks.en: We evaluate direct vision-language model inference using Qwen3-VL and InternVL3.5 at multiple model sizes. For these baselines, the model is given the artwork image and prompted to select the dominant emotion label directly. This setting evaluates whether current VLMs can infer evoked emotion from the image without the explicit visual-semantic graph structure used by our method.
blocks.zh: 我们使用 Quen3-VL 和 InternVL3.5 在多个模型大小上评价直接视觉语言模型推论. 对于这些基线来说,模型被赋予了艺术图像,并被促使直接选择主导情感标签. 这个设定评价了当前VLM是否能够推断出没有我们的方法所使用的清晰的视觉-语义图形结构而从图像中激发出情感.

blocks.en: Table 4 reports overall dominant emotion classification performance. For RQ1 , direct VLM inference provides a useful but still modest baseline. The best direct VLM is InternVL3.5-8B, with accuracy and weighted-F1 only slightly above 0.5. This result suggests that current VLMs can capture some broad affective cues, but artwork emotion prediction remains difficult because the emotional meaning of art is often implicit, subjective, and grounded in subtle relations among form, composition, and semantic association. This difficulty is not surprising, since interpreting emotion in art is challenging even for human viewers and often depends on context and personal perception.
blocks.zh: 表4汇报了总体主要情感分类绩效。 对RQ1来说,直接的VLM推论提供了一个有用但仍然微小的基线. 最好的直接VLM是InternVL3.5-8B,精度和加权-F1仅略高于0.5. 这个结果表明,目前的VLM可以捕捉出一些广义的感官提示,但艺术情感预测仍然很困难,因为艺术的情感意义常常是隐含的,主观的,并以形式,组成,和语义联系之间的微妙关系为基础. 这种困难并不出人意料,因为艺术中的情感解释甚至对人类观众来说都具有挑战性,而且往往取决于背景和个人感想.

blocks.en: The VLM results also show that larger parameter size does not necessarily lead to better emotion prediction. For example, Qwen3-VL-8B performs worse than its 2B and 4B variants on overall accuracy. One possible explanation is that direct emotion prediction is sensitive to prompt interpretation, label priors, and the model’s alignment behavior, rather than only to raw model capacity. Larger models may produce more complex or language-prior-driven judgments, but those judgments do not always match the true emotion.
blocks.zh: VLM结果还表明,更大的参数大小并不一定会导致更好的情感预测. 例如,Qune3-VL-8B在整体精确度上的表现比它的2B和4B变体差. 一个可能的解释是,直接的情感预测对即时解释,标签前科,以及模型的对接行为敏感,而不仅仅是对原始模型能力敏感. 较大的模型可能会产生更复杂的或由语言先导驱动的判断,但这些判断并不总是与真正的情感相匹配.

blocks.en: For RQ2 , the graph-based models generally outperform direct VLM inference on accuracy and weighted-F1. The strongest overall model is VSAG+VA , which achieves the best score across all three metrics. Compared with both the best direct VLM and the emotion-only VSAG baseline, this result shows that hierarchical valence-arousal modeling can improve dominant emotion prediction when it is integrated as a coarse-to-fine affect structure rather than as a post-hoc logit correction. The effect of VA is not uniform across graph aggregation strategies. While VSAG+VA improves over VSAG, VSAG-TopK+VA underperforms VSAG-TopK. This suggests that the VA hierarchy is more useful when affective evidence is aggregated across distributed feature paths, whereas sparse TopK pooling may already impose a strong evidence-selection bias.
blocks.zh: 对RQ2来说,以图表为基础的模型在精确度和加权-F1. 上一般优于直接的VLM推论. 最强的整体模型是VSAG+VA,它在所有三个度量衡上都取得了最佳分数. 与最佳直取VLM和只取情感的VSAG基线相比,这一结果显示,分级活性-激发模型在集成为粗到细的结构会影响结构,而不是作为后浩克对数的校正时,可以改善主情感预测. 不同图表汇总策略的VA效果并不统一. 虽然VSAG+VA比VSAG有所改进,但VSAG-TopK+VA的表现却不如VSAG-TopK. 这表明,当在分布式特征路径中将情感证据汇总起来时,VA等级更有用,而稀有的TopK集合可能已经造成了强烈的证据选择偏差.

blocks.en: Table 5 shows that the gains are concentrated in several negative or difficult classes. Compared with emotion-only VSAG, VSAG+VA improves Alarmed , Frustrated , and Sad , which contributes to its higher macro-F1. However, rare classes such as Glad , Aroused , Bored , Tired , and Annoyed remain difficult. Direct VLMs also remain stronger for some classes, suggesting that VLMs and graph-based models capture partly complementary affective signals.
blocks.zh: 表5显示,收益集中在几个负或困难阶层。 与仅以情感为主的VSAG相比,VSAG+VA改进了"惊吓","失落"和"萨德",后者促进了其更高的宏-F1. 然而,诸如Glad、Areated、Bored、疲倦和Annoyed等罕见的阶层仍然困难重重。 直接的VLM对于一些类来说也仍然比较强大,这表明VLM和以图表为基础的模型捕捉到部分互补的活性信号.

blocks.en: 4.3 Feature-Emotion Association Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.3 特征-情感协会分析

blocks.en: To answer RQ3 , we inspect the learned associations between visual-semantic feature nodes and emotion labels. Table 6 reports the top associated feature nodes for each emotion. The associations are obtained from feature-emotion log-odds scores estimated from the training set and used to initialize the VSAG feature-emotion edges. Each score indicates how strongly a feature is associated with an emotion label relative to its absence in the training set.
blocks.zh: 为了回答RQ3,我们检查了视觉语义特征节点和情感标签之间学到的关联. 表6报告每种情绪的顶级相关特征节点。 这些协会是从培训集估计的特征-情感记录码得分中获得的,用来初始化VSAG特征-情感边缘. 每个分数都表明一个特征与其在训练集中的缺席相比,与情感标签的关系有多强烈.

blocks.en: The associations reveal several interpretable patterns. High-arousal or negative emotions are often linked to visually intense features: Alarmed is associated with strong contrast, tense composition, and dramatic lighting, while Frustrated is associated with rough or energetic brushwork and strong contrast. In contrast, calmer positive emotions are linked to softer visual properties: Calm is associated with soft lighting, gentle brushwork, and balanced composition, while Contentment is associated with warm colors and domestic entities such as baby .
blocks.zh: 这些协会揭示了几种可解释的模式。 高刺激或负面情绪往往与视觉强烈特征相联: 震惊与强烈的对比、紧张的构成和戏剧性的照明有关,而沮丧与粗糙或充满活力的刷子和强烈的对比有关。 反之,更平和的积极情绪与更柔软的视觉属性相关: 平静与柔软的照明、温和的刷子和平衡的构成相关,而Content则与温暖的颜色和婴儿等家庭实体相关。

blocks.en: Table 6: Top-3 visual-semantic feature associations for each emotion. Each entry shows the feature node type, feature value, and association score in parentheses.
blocks.zh: 表6:每种情感的Top-3视觉-语义特征关联. 每个条目在括号中显示特征节点类型,特征值和关联分.

blocks.en: Figure 2: Feature-group mean association strength by emotion.
blocks.zh: 图 2: 地物-群体指由情感构成的关联力量.

blocks.en: Figure 2 summarizes the same associations at the feature-group level. It uses all positive feature-emotion associations whose feature node appears in at least five training artworks, computes the mean association strength for each feature group, and normalizes these values within each emotion. The results indicate a relatively balanced contribution across feature groups, with no single group consistently dominating across all emotion labels: color is prominent for Excited and Sad , light-shadow for Alarmed , brushstroke for Frustrated and Calm , and entity nodes for labels such as Glad , Bored , Tired , and Annoyed .
blocks.zh: 图2汇总了在专题小组一级的相同协会。 它使用所有正面的特征-情感协会,其特征节点出现在至少五个训练作品中,计算每个特征组的平均关联强度,并使每个情感中的这些价值观正常化. 照片显示各功能组的贡献相对均衡, 没有一个单一的组一直占据着所有情感标签的主导地位:色彩为兴奋和悲伤; 浅影为震惊; 刷子为沮丧和冷静;

blocks.en: However, note that these values should be interpreted as learned feature-emotion associations rather than causal feature importance. Some associations, especially for rare classes such as Glad may reflect limited support and should therefore be interpreted cautiously. Accordingly, this analysis is best interpreted as descriptive evidence of which visual-semantic feature groups are most strongly associated with each emotion label.
blocks.zh: 然而,要注意的是,这些价值观应被解释为已学到的特征-情感协会,而不是因果重要性。 一些协会,特别是对于诸如Glad等罕见的类别,可能反映的支持有限,因此应谨慎解释。 因此,这一分析最好被解释为描述性证据,其中视觉语义特征组与每个情感标签关系最密切.

blocks.en: 5 Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论情况

blocks.en: Our results show that explicit visual-semantic structure is useful for artwork emotion prediction, but the task remains difficult. One reason is that emotion in art is rarely limited to a single label: an artwork may evoke multiple emotions, and different viewers may interpret it differently. Since the dataset provides only one dominant emotion label per artwork, models are trained to match a specific annotation choice rather than the full range of possible affective responses. The graph formulation partly addresses this limitation by producing scores for all emotion nodes, which allows secondary emotions and feature-emotion paths to be inspected.
blocks.zh: 我们的结果显示,清晰的视觉语义结构对于艺术情感预测是有用的,但任务仍然很困难. 其中一个原因是,艺术中的情感很少局限于一个单一的标签:一幅艺术品可能激发出多种情感,不同的观众可能对其有不同的解释. 由于数据集只提供每件艺术品一个占主导地位的情感标签,因此对模型进行了培训,使其与具体的注释选择相匹配,而不是与各种可能的情感反应相匹配。 图表配方通过为所有情感节点生成分数来部分地解决了这一限制,从而可以检查次级情感和特征-情感路径.

blocks.en: The comparison with direct VLM inference suggests that VLMs and graph-based models capture complementary signals. VLMs may rely on global visual impressions and broad semantic priors, while VSAG uses explicit feature nodes such as color, brushstroke, composition, light-shadow, line quality, and visual entities. This makes VSAG more interpretable, but also dependent on feature quality and coverage. The +VA results show that valence-arousal hierarchy improves standard VSAG, mainly by helping several negative or less frequent classes. However, this benefit does not transfer to VSAG-TopK, suggesting that VA structure is most useful with distributed feature-path aggregation, while TopK pooling may already emphasize dominant affective cues. The persistent near-zero performance on rare labels shows that long-tailed affect supervision remains a major challenge, motivating future investigation of class-reweighting, focal loss, or graph-based sampling strategies. Multi-label emotion annotation may also better reflect the range of affective responses that an artwork can evoke.
blocks.zh: 与直接VLM推论的比较表明,VLM和以图表为基础的模型捕捉到互补信号. VLM可能依赖于全局视觉印象和广义语义前传,而VSAG则使用明显的特征节点,如颜色,刷弦,组成,光影,行质量,和视觉实体等. 这使得VSAG更能解释,但也取决于特征质量和覆盖范围. +VA的结果显示,活性-激发分级提高了标准VSAG,主要通过帮助几个负或更不频繁的分级. 然而,这个好处并没有转移到VSAG-TopK,这表明VA结构在分布式地物-路径聚合中最有用,而TopK集合可能已经强调主动提示. 稀有标签上持续近于零的性能表明,长尾影响监督仍然是一项重大挑战,促使今后对分级加权、焦点损失或以图表为基础的取样战略进行调查。 多标签的情感注释也可以更好地反映艺术品可以引发的情感反应范围。

blocks.en: Finally, a further limitation is that the current graph mainly uses visual-semantic features and does not yet incorporate non-visual contextual information such as artist, year, medium, style period, or cultural background, which may affect emotional interpretation. Previous work has shown that such contextual knowledge can be represented through knowledge graphs and combined with visual information for artwork emotion recognition [ 8 ] . In addition, our current graph-based evaluation primarily compares variants of VSAG rather than independently developed graph-based approaches. Future work could therefore incorporate external art knowledge into VSAG to construct a richer artwork knowledge graph and evaluate it against existing knowledge-graph-based methods.
blocks.zh: 最后,另一个限制是,目前的图表主要使用视觉语义特征,尚未包含艺术家,年,中,作风期等非视觉背景信息,或文化背景,可能影响情感解释. 以往的研究表明,这种背景知识可以通过知识图表来体现,并结合视觉信息进行艺术情感识别[8]. 此外,我们目前的以图表为基础的评价主要比较VSAG的变体,而不是独立的以图表为基础的方法。 因此,今后的工作可以将外部艺术知识纳入VSAG,以构建一个更丰富的艺术知识图并参照现有的以知识为基础的方法加以评价。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: Our work studied artwork emotion prediction using Visual-Semantic Affect Graphs, which represent artworks through interpretable visual and semantic feature nodes and learn their associations with emotion labels. Experiments on EmoArt-5k show that direct VLM inference provides a useful but modest baseline, while graph-based models improve dominant emotion prediction. The best overall model is VSAG+VA, which integrates valence-arousal structure through a hierarchical auxiliary affect formulation and achieves the highest accuracy, macro-F1, and weighted-F1 among the evaluated models. The results also show that the benefit of VA structure depends on the graph aggregation strategy: it improves standard VSAG, but not VSAG-TopK. Per-class analysis shows that hierarchical VA modeling improves several difficult negative emotions, while rare classes remain challenging because of severe label imbalance. Feature-emotion analysis identifies interpretable associations between emotions and visual-semantic cues such as contrast, brushwork, composition, lighting, and entities. Future work can extend VSAG toward multi-label emotion modeling, richer art-historical metadata, and hybrid models that combine VLM representations with interpretable graph structure.
blocks.zh: 我们的作品研究了用视觉-语义感知图的艺术情感预测,这些艺术通过可解释的视觉和语义特征节点代表艺术,并用情感标签来学习其关联。 EmoArt-5k上的实验显示,直接的VLM推论提供了有用而适度的基线,而以图表为基础的模型则能改善占优势的情感预测. 最好的整体模型是VSAG+VA,它通过分级辅助来整合活性-振荡结构会影响配制,并在被评价的模型中达到最高的精度,宏-F1和加权-F1. 结果还表明VA结构的效益取决于图集策略:它改进了标准VSAG,但不是VSAG-TopK. 每类分析显示,分级VA建模改进了几种困难的负面情绪,而罕见的分类由于标签严重失衡而依然具有挑战性. 特征感知分析确定了情感和视觉语义提示之间的可解释关联,如对比,刷子活,组成,照明等实体. 未来的工作可以将VSAG扩展至多标签情感模型,更丰富的艺术-历史元数据,以及将VLM表示和可解释的图表结构相结合的混合模型.
